passage:
Andy forgot his lunch money. He did not want to tell anyone, so he sat quietly while others bought food.
His classmate Mei noticed. She bought an extra rice ball and placed it on his desk. "I bought too much," she said.
Andy knew she was being kind without making him feel embarrassed.
The next day, he returned the money and thanked her. Mei said, "You can help someone else next time."
A week later, Andy saw another student searching his pockets near the cafeteria. Andy understood immediately and offered help.
Kindness is not only about giving. It is also about protecting someone's dignity while giving.
